logical_equivalence_scope: Exact residual-language BFS for positive Boolean/X/U/F/G formulas on nonempty finite traces. A state cap produces unknown. Counterexamples saved for inequivalent pairs. Residual evaluator cross-checked against existing checker on 21000 random/boundary traces.
multi_proposition: Unrestricted subsets, including empty states and simultaneous atoms. No exclusive-action assumption in semantic tests.
template_precedence: G(!b) OR (!b U (a AND !b)); strict earlier a required for first b. Unlike event-exclusive syntax, simultaneous a,b does not count as precedence.
